Consta d'una barra de 3'5 metres amb 4 tamborets, tirador de cervesa, boteller de 4 portes, contra barra d'1'5 metres amb 3 tamborets i office de 6m². Local insonoritzat amb 1 lavabo, magatzem al pati i aire condicionat.

inv.desc_en:
Ref. T-3188-08 C1 Bar for lease, 90 m2 distributed over 1 floor, capacity for 28 diners, with a 2.5-meter glass facade and one entrance. It consists of a 3.5-meter bar with 4 stools, beer tap, 4-door bottle rack, 1.5-meter back bar with 3 stools, and a 6m² pantry/prep area. Soundproofed premises with 1 restroom, storage in the patio, and air conditioning.

Lease: €51,000 RENT: €700 + VAT - Personal Income Tax.
Contract: 10 years
Incasol deposit: 2 months - Additional guarantee: 2 months.
